# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 16 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Land Supply: Two GLS Sites Launched in Prime Locations

- **Government releases two Central Region GLS sites in Orchard Boulevard and Marina South** - Tenders have been launched for a 37,006 sq ft plot at Orchard Boulevard and a 64,663 sq ft site at Marina Gardens Lane, with the two sites together capable of adding around 500 private homes to the pipeline. Analysts expect strong bids given recent sales momentum. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/2-prime-residential-sites-released-orchard-marina-south/)

## HDB Market: Records, Upgrading Trends and Resale Picks

- **Clementi Crest repeatedly breaks Clementi's town-wide HDB resale price records** - The project only reached its Minimum Occupation Period in 2025 and has already pushed up Clementi's resale benchmarks multiple times within just over a year. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/clementi-crest-hdb-resale-record-prices/)

- **Survey: Only 55% of HDB owners still aspire to private housing** - A 2026 PropNex survey of 1,530 HDB owners found that 77% now prioritise accessibility and neighbourhood ties over prestige when thinking about their next home, with private housing aspirations falling to 55.1%. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/a-new-survey-reveals-what-77-of-hdb-owners-want-most-in-their-next-home-and-its-not-price-or-space/)

- **Five 4-room HDB flats under $450,000 still available across several towns** - Affordable 4-room resale flats are listed in Marsiling, Yishun, Toa Payoh, Bukit Batok and Teck Whye, each described as offering spacious layouts and MRT access. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/here-are-5-of-the-cheapest-4-room-hdb-flats-you-can-still-buy-all-under-450k/)

## Lease Decay and Older Stock: A Growing Consideration

- **Lease decay increasingly affects CPF usage, financing and resale ease as Singapore's housing stock ages** - A Q&A piece addresses how a shortening remaining lease on older properties can affect buyers across multiple dimensions, from bank loan eligibility to future demand. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ask-an-agent-your-lease-decay-property-questions-answered/)
